Incident response team notified for manual intervention and process review. Corrective actions scheduled under change control.

arguments.summary: A coordinated attack originated from the compromise of user jsmith's workstation (WS-FIN-042), leading to credential theft, lateral movement, and exposure of the admin_jsmith account. The attacker used Cobalt Strike for C2 communication, attempted Kerberos exploitation, and exfiltrated credentials which appeared on the dark web. Multiple alerts across SSH brute-force, credential leak, and anomalous access were correlated to confirm a single incident involving privilege escalation and potential data access.

timeline.description: Initial compromise: Suspicious outbound HTTPS connection from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to known Cobalt Strike C2 server (198.51.100.23).
Malicious process execution detected: rundll32.exe launched from Temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS alert triggered: 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity' confirmed malicious traffic from WS-FIN-042.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042 for admin_jsmith, indicating credential misuse attempt.
Lateral movement via SMB to file server (10.0.5.50) using admin_jsmith credentials.
Alert INC-2026-1203A: SSH brute-force detected from 10.0.5.14 (mapped to WS-FIN-042) targeting bastion host.
Alert INC-2026-1203B: admin_jsmith credentials detected on dark web breach paste; hash match confirms exposure.
Alert INC-2026-1203C: Anomalous Kerberos TGS request for admin_jsmith from unauthorized workstation (10.0.6.99).
Correlation complete: All alerts linked to initial compromise of WS-FIN-042 and credential theft.
Response initiated: admin_jsmith account credentials revoked and reset; WS-FIN-042 isolated via firewall rules.
